notes: No official source reachable (checked 2026-09-17; mu2e.fnal.gov returned 403) gives building-level coordinates for the Mu2e hall. The point recorded is a general Fermilab-site geocoder point, not specific to the Mu2e hall.

summary.plain: The building at Fermilab, near Chicago, where the Mu2e experiment is being built: a chain of three giant superconducting magnets that will search for a muon turning directly into an electron.
summary.technical: Mu2e experimental hall on the Fermilab site, housing the production, transport and detector solenoids, straw tracker, crystal calorimeter and cosmic ray veto of the Mu2e experiment. No building-specific sourced coordinate was found; the recorded point is a campus-level approximate point.
